The VRChat client does not seem to reload / discover changes done to test avatars when the game is open.
You have to close and open it again to reload local test avatars.
[Scenario 1]
1. Have the game open
2. Build & Test avatar with new ID
3. Go to game, and see the new avatar does not show up in the "Others" avatar tab until you restart the game.
[Scenario 2]
1. Have the game open.
2. In Unity, go to Content Manager and remove test avatars you don't want to use anymore
3. Go to VRChat, the avatars will still appear, but if you click them, they show error avatar.
You need to restart vrchat client for changes to take effect.

comments.value: This problem still persists, despite the "Uploads" category issue having been fixed.

Issue still persists not even the `--watch-avatars` launch flag fixes this issue...

also I'm pretty sure vrchat doesn't even reload the Build & Test avatar when you change out and back into it

My current workaround

1. Locate %appdata%/../LocalLow/VRChat/VRChat/Avatars

2. Upload test avatar avi1, duplicate it and rename the copy to avi2

3. Edit avi1 and test upload

4. Rename avi1 to avi2

5. In game switch to an other avatar than avi2 and then back to it

Repeat 3-5 whenever you upload the test avatar

This is a bit tedious workaround but better than restarting the game for every upload.
